selection.topic: 为什么AI模型只是变便宜一些，却可能让一批以前不值得交给AI的工作突然值得了？
selection.mechanism: A capability-per-cost improvement can move a task across the economic viability threshold for AI delegation even when the task itself has not changed.
selection.human_problem: 为什么一个昨天还嫌贵、不值得自动化的AI任务，今天可能突然值得交给模型做？
selection.audience_payoff: 理解模型更新真正改变现实的一个方式，是改变哪些任务在成本上值得交给AI，而不只是榜单分数变高。
selection.guardrail: Do not claim a 40% model-runtime reduction equals 40% end-to-end workflow savings; total cost also depends on tokens, retries, tools, latency and human review.
